notes: Variant WLC.JER.2.27.v006 selected r01 for s013-s014; the ASV's 'Thou hast brought me forth' matches the projection and the footnote records the 'us' reading. Token counts are equal, so rule 53 does not engage.

s019 and s022 give the supplied 'their' of 'their back' and 'their face' to the nouns under rule 15. This is contestable: rule 18's closing sentence marks a supplied possessive expression added where no suffix is present. The reading stands because rule 18's target is the emphatic 'own' possessive, while 'their' here fills a determiner slot English grammar requires, which is the same licensing rule 15 gives a supplied article; a later reader may prefer two added units instead.
s030 is tagged Sh, so it is the cohortative he of rule 32's first sentence and not a directive Sd.
